title: Feature Request:  Added data elements in the interapp web service
body: Am using the inter app web service feature to interact with my Fitbit Versa and would love to get more info out of the service to show on my watch, specifically the "insulin on board (iob)" datapoint.  Is this possible?

comments.body: Figured this one out.  If I use the nightscout site url + /pebble... I get json response with iob and cob data.  Works like a charm.
